name: Cheese Cracker Gold
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED VEGETABLE OILS (PALM & PALMOLEIN), SUGAR, LIQUID GLUCOSE, IODISED COMMON SALT, BUTTER (2%), PROCESSED CHEESE (1%) PERMITTED EMULSIFIERS [LECITHIN (E322(i)), DIACETYLTARTARIC AND FATTY ACID ESTERS OF GLYCEROL [E472 LEAVENING AGENTS AMMONIUM BICARBONATE (E503), SODIUM BICARBONATE (E500X)]. ACID SALT [SODIUM ACID PYROPHOSPHATE (80(0))]. DOUGH CONDITIONER (SODIUM METABISULPHITE (E223) DOUGH IMPROVERS AMYLASES (E1100(1)), FROTEASES (EN))]. CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC COLOURS (TARTRAZINE (E102), ALLURA RED AC (E129)] AND ADDED ARTIFICIAL SYSTEM)
